text:
Gold Price in 1997
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1997, the LBMA gold price fell 16.0% between 1997-01-31 ($346) and 1997-12-30 ($290). The highest sampled price was $359 in February and the lowest was $290 in December. The mean of these observations was $330. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
